payload.reason: The evidence describes how the paper integrates a language model with cross-lingual word embeddings to enhance context-aware search for translation tasks.

claims.text: The paper integrates a language model (LM) with cross-lingual word embedding to improve context-aware word translation.
Context-aware lexical choices are achieved using beam search with the language model, which assists in selecting the appropriate word based on context.
The language model helps in addressing reordering issues in translations, although it does not modify the word order directly.
